extracted.name: Lemon-Glazed Carrots
extracted.description: Carrots are pan-fried in a sweet lemony glaze creating a quick and easy side dish.
ingredient_lines: 1 pinch salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Place carrots into a large pot and cover with water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until carrots are tender, about 8 minutes. Drain.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat; cook and stir carrots, brown sugar, and lemon juice in the melted butter, stirring often, until sugar has dissolved, 2 minutes.
